title: AI says you’re right, formal methods say you’re wrong
paragraphs: Ryan is joined by Gabriela Moreira, CEO at Quint, about why formal specification languages like TLA+ are essential for catching system design flaws before writing code, how Quint brings developer-friendly syntax and executability to formal methods, and the ways trace validation and model-based testing can verify AI-generated code against real-world production data.

<!--[-->Quint<!--]--> is an open-source, executable specification language and toolchain based on TLA+ that enables engineers to model, simulate, and verify system behaviors using an intuitive, programmer-friendly syntax.
Congrats to Populist badge winner <!--[-->Alex K.<!--]--> for winning the badge on their answer to <!--[-->SQL Server: Select Top 0?<!--]--> .
